g.aria-label: σ = g / √n_in (g = √2 for ReLU, g = 1 linear); defaults decay deep stacks
net.apply(fn) overwrites leaf weights in place while preserving references
Redraws |w| > 2σ (shrinks std by 0.88×) to eliminate >5σ outliers at 10⁸ scale
m_{k+1} = (1 + g²) m_k ⇒ unscaled g=1 explodes std by 2^{N/2} (65,536× at N=32)
Scale output projection by g = 1/√N (std ≤ √e ≈ 1.65×) or g = 0 (identity start)
